description: This file defines the CommandResultProcessor class, which is a background service responsible for processing queued command results from Redis, updating the database with new assets and findings, and sending notifications. It handles deserialization of job data, processing results, database updates, error handling, and notification enqueuing.

classes.name: CommandResultProcessor
classes.description: A background service that continuously processes command result jobs from a Redis queue, updates related data in the database, and sends notifications based on the processing results.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: The main loop of the background service that fetches jobs from Redis, deserializes them, processes command results, updates the database, and enqueues notifications.

methods.name: GetAssetId
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the ID of an asset from the database, adding it if it does not exist.
